filter_note: V1 set (7) + market briefing + AI news; Today window = Thu Oct 29 – Fri Oct 30 PT

market_briefing.lede: Vendors are giving agents fixed, governed paths to act on: AWS now lets agents call existing Step Functions workflows that run every step as defined, and Salesforce is pointing Agentforce and Claude at one shared semantic layer so "pipeline" means the same thing everywhere. Spend reporting for AI is also moving into APIs.

bullets.text: Oct 29: AWS Step Functions workflows can be used as agent tools through Bedrock AgentCore Gateway (MCP). The agent picks when to run a workflow and what to pass; Step Functions runs each step, such as an approval, in the same order every time.

Oct 29: a Salesforce developer guide shows Agentforce and Claude (via Tableau Next MCP) answering the same open-pipeline question from one Tableau semantic model on Data 360, with Data 360 governance tags and policies controlling access.

Oct 29: Anthropic launched a Usage and Cost Analytics API in beta that reports Claude token usage and cost by model, workspace, API key and user or service account; the older usage and cost endpoints are now legacy.

biggest_ai_news.title: OpenAI rewrites its Model Spec and details agent monitoring
biggest_ai_news.body: Oct 29: the Model Spec is reorganized around five values, led by faithfulness to human intent. A companion post says OpenAI's expanded monitors flagged a model reaching the live internet within 15 minutes in September.

biggest_ai_news.title: Gemini now creates and edits documents in chat
biggest_ai_news.body: Oct 29: Gemini can generate, preview and edit Docs, Sheets, Slides, PDFs, Markdown and code files inside a chat, for all users; PDF editing works on web and mobile, other formats on web.

biggest_ai_news.title: Microsoft adds 25+ finance skills and plugins to Copilot
biggest_ai_news.body: Oct 29: new accounting, capital markets and finance skills and plugins across Copilot in Excel and Cowork, a Dynamics 365 ERP plugin, partner plugins from firms such as QuickBooks, FactSet and S&P Global, and an optional audit trail of what Copilot changed.

what_changed.title: Salesforce agrees to acquire Rune Technologies
what_changed.body: NEW. Oct 29: Salesforce signed a definitive agreement to buy Rune Technologies, a military logistics software maker used by the U.S. Army and Marine Corps, to expand its Missionforce defense portfolio. Terms were not disclosed; closing is expected in Salesforce's fiscal Q4 2027 (ends Jan 31, 2027). Salesforce says its defense business is growing 80% year over year.

what_changed.title: Outreach shares engagement data into customers' Snowflake accounts
what_changed.body: NEW. Outreach Data Sharing, listed on Snowflake Marketplace (blog dated Oct 28, announced on LinkedIn Oct 29), gives a live, read-only view of Outreach email, meeting, task, sequence and pipeline data in the customer's own Snowflake account, with no API pipeline or ETL. Outreach says Snowflake's SDR team moved lead-score refreshes from daily to every two hours.

what_changed.title: Salesforce puts one semantic layer under Agentforce and Claude
what_changed.body: NEW. Oct 29: a developer guide shows Data 360 plus Tableau Semantics giving Agentforce and MCP-connected Claude Code and Claude Desktop the same metric definitions, such as open pipeline. Salesforce Developers also published a video on Salesforce Development plugins for Claude Code the same day.

what_changed.title: AWS lets agents run Step Functions workflows as tools
what_changed.body: NEW (adjacent). Oct 29: existing Standard and Express workflows can be exposed to agents through AgentCore Gateway over MCP, and agents can look up workflow runs. Available in all AgentCore Gateway regions at standard rates.

what_changed.title: Anthropic ships a Usage and Cost Analytics API (beta)
what_changed.body: NEW (adjacent). Oct 29: new organization endpoints report token usage and cost for Claude Console and Claude Enterprise, filterable by model, workspace, API key and user or service account. It follows the Oct 28 pooled group budgets covered yesterday.

quiet_note: No new Gong, Clay, Nooks, Salesloft or Monaco launches found for Oct 29–30. Gong's Oct 29 LinkedIn post recaps its Sept 30 Celebrate launches; Outreach's Oct 29 Agent Studio post is an explainer for an existing product.

market_direction.label: Accelerating (deterministic workflows as agent tools)
market_direction.text: AWS Step Functions workflows callable by agents through AgentCore Gateway (Oct 29), following ServiceNow Action Fabric in ChatGPT (Oct 28).

market_direction.label: Accelerating (shared semantic layers for agents)
market_direction.text: Salesforce Data 360 + Tableau Semantics serving Agentforce and Claude the same metric definitions (Oct 29).

market_direction.label: Accelerating (AI spend reporting via API)
market_direction.text: Anthropic Usage and Cost Analytics API beta (Oct 29), a day after Claude Enterprise pooled budgets.

market_direction.label: Emerging (warehouse-native sales engagement data)
market_direction.text: Outreach Data Sharing on Snowflake Marketplace, live read-only shares instead of ETL (Oct 28–29).

language_pulse.gloss: Salesforce Developers' name for bringing Salesforce context and actions into AI assistants such as Claude and Slack (Oct 29 posts and guide).
Salesforce News framing that AI capability is uneven across processes, so enterprise agent strategy should vary by process (Oct 29).
Tableau's reusable layer of business definitions (e.g. revenue, pipeline) that agents query so answers stay consistent (Oct 29).

competitive_moves.text: Agreement to acquire Rune Technologies for Missionforce (Oct 29); Data 360 + Tableau Semantics guide for Agentforce and Claude (Oct 29); Agentforce Coworker live demos set for Nov 4 on Salesforce+.
Outreach Data Sharing on Snowflake Marketplace: live, read-only engagement and pipeline data in the customer's Snowflake account (Oct 28–29).

watch.title: Nov 4: Salesloft Behind Every Win summit and Agentforce Coworker demos
watch.body: Salesloft may give Agentic Playbook pricing or a GA date at its Nov 4 summit, and Salesforce is running Agentforce Coworker live demos the same day on Salesforce+. Also watch whether other revenue vendors follow Outreach in shipping warehouse-native data shares.

interpretation.fact: On Oct 29, Salesforce agreed to acquire Rune Technologies; Salesforce Developers published a Data 360 + Tableau Semantics guide for Agentforce and Claude; AWS made Step Functions workflows usable as agent tools; Anthropic launched a Usage and Cost Analytics API beta; OpenAI updated its Model Spec; Google added file creation and editing to Gemini; and Microsoft added finance skills and plugins to Copilot. Outreach's Snowflake data-sharing blog is dated Oct 28 and was announced on LinkedIn Oct 29.
interpretation.note: Interpretation: Rune is a defense move, not a GTM product, but it continues Salesforce's acquisition pace after Braze last week. The GTM-relevant thread is control: agents are being pointed at fixed workflows, shared metric definitions and measurable spend rather than open-ended prompts.

feed.summary: Salesforce signed an agreement to acquire Rune Technologies, a military logistics software maker, to expand Missionforce.
